question: The word ‘Swaraj’ was first used by Dadabhai Naoroji in the Congress session held in which place?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Calcutta**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **'Swaraj'** was first used by **Dadabhai Naoroji** in the Congress session held in **Calcutta** in 1906.
 
• Dadabhai Naoroji, also known as the **Grand Old Man of India**, was a prominent Indian nationalist and a founding member of the Indian National Congress.
 
• The term **'Swaraj'** means self-rule or self-governance and became a key concept in the Indian independence movement.
 
• This session of the Congress marked a significant shift towards the demand for complete independence from British rule.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dadabhai Naoroji** was the first Indian to be elected to the British Parliament, where he advocated for Indian rights and self-governance.
 
• The **Indian National Congress** was founded in 1885 and played a crucial role in the struggle for Indian independence.
 
• The concept of **Swaraj** was later popularized by other leaders like **Bal Gangadhar Tilak** and **Mahatma Gandhi**.
 
• In 1929, the Congress session at Lahore, presided over by **Jawaharlal Nehru**, declared 'Purna Swaraj' or complete independence as its goal.
